recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future jurisdiction-specific tax-type breakdowns should be handled by profiles/extensions or a new tracker rather than changing the base resource now.
issue_request: FHIR-29689 was a Published/Persuasive Financial Management R5 change request asking to add tax support at Claim item/detail/subDetail, ClaimResponse addItem/detail/subDetail, and ExplanationOfBenefit item/detail/subDetail plus addItem/detail/subDetail. The approved resolution selected a single `.tax 0..1 Money` element for the affected structures, left tax breakdowns to extensions, and said jurisdictional implementation guides/profiles should handle jurisdiction-specific tax treatment.
initial_application: No git commit message found in the current repository history explicitly names FHIR-29689. Commit 75e9d09e28 added the current Money tax elements to the three Claim structures, three ClaimResponse.addItem structures, and six ExplanationOfBenefit item/addItem structures. Later net-definition work, including FHIR-37594, clarified the same Claim-family .net elements after the tax additions.
additional_context: FHIR-30926 is the tightly related later Published/Persuasive-with-Modification issue; its final comment says it has the same resolution as FHIR-29689 and its final resolution also narrows tax from a type/amount backbone to `.tax 0..1 Money`. FHIR-37594 is a later Published/Persuasive clarification for the same resources that states `Net = unit price * quantity * factor`, and the combined branch already contains the AutoFHIR FHIR-37594 requirements correction. The relevant Claim, ClaimResponse, and ExplanationOfBenefit resources are active current-build resources in source/fhir.ini.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source already has the requested tax Money elements in all approved structures, the later net wording now reflects the current approved formula, and adding tax-type children or a separate diagnosisRelatedGroup tax element would go beyond the final FHIR-29689/FHIR-30926 source application.
